colrows=defaultdict(set)

def solve(limit=5):
 sols=[]; nodes=[0]
 def rec(remaining_cols, available_rows, chosen):
  nodes[0]+=1
  if len(sols)>=limit: return
  if not remaining_cols:
   sols.append(chosen[:]);return
  # select most constrained column
  best=None; options=None
  for col in remaining_cols:
   opts=available_rows & colrows[col]
   if not opts: return
   if options is None or len(opts)<len(options):
    best=col;options=opts
    if len(opts)==1: break
  for ri in list(options):
   cols=rowcols[ri]
   rec(remaining_cols-cols,available_rows - set().union(*(colrows[c] for c in cols)),chosen+[ri])
   if len(sols)>=limit:return
 rec(allcols,set(range(len(rows))),[])
 return sols,nodes[0]
